tasks.label: Dev: First-run setup
tasks.detail: Creates private synthetic development config if absent; installs shared actions.

tasks.label: Dev: Refresh editor actions
tasks.detail: Installs or refreshes shared OpenChamber actions only; does not create or change .env.

tasks.label: Dev: Start services
tasks.detail: Starts server, database, and S3 tooling containers; waits for healthy state.

tasks.label: Dev: Stop services
tasks.detail: Stops and removes tooling containers while preserving named data volumes.

tasks.label: Dev: Build server
tasks.detail: Builds the server inside the development container.

tasks.label: Dev: Test server
tasks.detail: Runs Rust tests inside the development container.

tasks.label: Dev: Run gateway demo (simulated)
tasks.detail: Runs an isolated simulated gateway demo with synthetic credentials, not real .env.

tasks.label: Android: Build debug APK
tasks.detail: Builds a debug-signed APK in the optional Android container.

tasks.label: Android: Start emulator
tasks.detail: Reuses one running emulator or starts one configured AVD; refuses ambiguous choices, returns when ready, and leaves it running.

tasks.label: Android: Deploy to emulator
tasks.detail: Installs the debug APK on a running emulator; physical devices are rejected.

tasks.label: Android: Run instrumentation smoke
tasks.detail: Runs instrumentation on an emulator and propagates test failures.

tasks.label: Android: Send default synthetic SMS (emulator only)
tasks.command: bash infra/dev/dev.sh android-sms +15555550123 "synthetic OpenPush test message"
tasks.detail: Sends the default synthetic SMS through the emulator console; emulator only, never a carrier service.

tasks.label: Desktop: Dev mode
tasks.detail: Runs unsigned macOS Tauri development or native Windows Tauri from WSL PowerShell; plain Linux is unsupported.

tasks.label: Desktop: Build development bundle
tasks.detail: Builds a macOS development bundle with no Developer ID signing or notarization, or a Windows development bundle through WSL PowerShell; plain Linux is unsupported.

tasks.label: Desktop: Build and run latest app
tasks.detail: Builds then opens the latest development bundle as a fresh instance; does not open if the build fails; plain Linux is unsupported.

tasks.label: Desktop: Open built app
tasks.detail: Opens the current built app in place without a global installation; plain Linux is unsupported.
